# Product Roadmap Overview Q4 2024

**Distribution:** All Employees (Internal)
**Status:** Confidential — Do Not Share Externally

## Q4 2024 Priorities

### Feature 1: AI-Assisted Reporting (In Progress)
Enable customers to generate natural language reports from their data using
built-in AI summarization. This feature is in final QA and expected to GA on
November 15. Customer-facing marketing goes live simultaneously.

### Feature 2: SSO Integration Expansion (In Progress)
Adding support for Okta and Microsoft Azure AD SAML 2.0 in addition to
existing Google Workspace SSO. Target GA: December 1.

### Feature 3: Advanced Audit Logging (Planning)
Complete audit trail for all data access and configuration changes, designed
to support enterprise compliance requirements (SOC2, HIPAA). Design complete;
development begins November 1. Target GA: Q1 2025.

### Feature 4: Mobile Application v2.0 (Planning)
Complete redesign of the mobile app with offline capabilities and enhanced
push notifications. Discovery phase complete. Development begins Q4.
Target GA: Q2 2025.

## What's On Hold

The following were planned for Q4 but have been deprioritized:
- Customer-facing API v3 (pushed to Q1 2025 due to resource constraints)
- White-labeling feature (requires architectural changes; Q2 2025 at earliest)

## Beta Program

If you know customers interested in beta access to AI-Assisted Reporting,
contact the Product team at product@company.internal. We are targeting
20 design partners.

## Note on External Communication

Do not share feature names, dates, or any specifics from this roadmap with
customers or external parties without Product Marketing approval. Messaging
is being prepared for coordinated launch announcements.
